visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of the finished Tofu Skin Egg Pancake, sliced into thick rolls revealing layers of green herbs and red chilies. The lighting is bright and warm, accentuating the golden-brown crispy texture of the egg. (2) Hands in a bright studio kitchen crack three eggs into a glass bowl; salt and spices are added. The background is a clean wooden tabletop. (3) The chef adds chopped red and green chilies, basil, and cilantro into the egg mixture and stirs vigorously with chopsticks. (4) Oil is poured into a black non-stick pan followed by the egg mixture, which is spread evenly. (5) Large sheets of tofu skin are placed carefully over the semi-set egg. (6) The camera shifts to a medium shot of the male chef in a white professional jacket; he flips the pancake high into the air with a confident pan toss against a blue wall background with a cartoon window. (7) The pancake is rolled tightly using a black spatula and then moved to a cutting board where it is sliced into segments. (8) Final presentation shows the stacked pancakes with a green garnish and text overlays appearing at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM and an enthusiastic male narrator introducing the dish. The vocal tone is high-energy with rising intonations. (2) A sharp 'crack' sound occurs as an egg is broken, followed by the clinking of glass as seasonings are poured. (3) Rhythmic whisking sounds are heard against the BGM as the narrator describes the mixing process. (4) A soft sizzle emerges as oil and egg hit the pan, accompanied by a 'whoosh' transition SFX. (5) As the chef flips the pancake, he lets out an excited vocal grunt ('Hoi!'), punctuated by the rhythmic metallic thud of the pan. (6) Scraping sounds from a spatula are heard as the pancake is rolled. (7) A clear thudding sound of a knife hitting a wooden board occurs repeatedly during the cutting phase. (8) The BGM swells slightly for the outro, finishing with a final enthusiastic call to watch the full video.
